name: Lethtendris's Web
label: Quest
description: Lethtendris's Web: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The blood elf Lethtendris has overstepped her bounds. So eager was she to gather magical power that she defied her brethren and created a device of insidious design, a web meant to siphon the tainted magical energies of Dire Maul. Even now she gathers those energies and plans to release them against her enemies.
Lethtendris must be stopped. Find her within the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul, defeat her and bring her web to me so that it might be returned to more clear-headed blood elves for study.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, do you have Lethtendris's Web?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. This web holds within it vast stores of the magic of Dire Maul, and I fear what damage may be unleashed if those energies were harnessed by one so irresponsible as Lethtendris. I am saddened by her death, but I know that she could never part with her web while alive.
Thank you, friend. I will send the web to students of magic more responsible than Lethtendris. They will be the new wardens of its power.
